subject: Annotate differentially methylated regions keeping  (pvalue, qvalue and meth.diff) fileds on the result

messages.author: eb5c6aa9d41336d1
messages.subject: Annotate differentially methylated regions keeping  (pvalue, qvalue and meth.diff) fileds on the result
parts:
Dear all,

While using this remarkable package I come into an issue that I seem unable to solve easily.

# After calculating differential methylation (DM) step of the Methylkit manual,

myDiff=calculateDiffMeth(meth)

# I extract significative DM genes

myDiff25p=get.methylDiff(myDiff,difference=25,qvalue=0.01)


# The resulting myDiff25p, object has the following columns: "chr", "start", "end", "strand", "pvalue", "qvalue", "meth.diff"

head(myDiff25p)

#methylDiff object with 6 rows
#--------------
#     chr    start      end strand       pvalue       qvalue meth.diff
#143 chr1  5493084  5493084      + 2.362381e-05 2.670972e-04 -22.28056
#187 chr1  6413529  6413529      + 7.964851e-12 3.035633e-10 -32.94518
#226 chr1  7861787  7861787      - 0.000000e+00 0.000000e+00 -39.77778
#295 chr1  9789109  9789109      + 0.000000e+00 0.000000e+00 -35.58113
#378 chr1 10695361 10695361      - 0.000000e+00 0.000000e+00 -29.72180
#484 chr1 13244937 13244937      - 0.000000e+00 0.000000e+00 -26.57992
#--------------








# Then I annotate myDiff25p with nearest TSS (showing only the last lines)

 diffAnn <- annotate.WithGenicParts(myDiff25p, gene.obj)


#Therefore, diffAnn columns are: "target.row","dist.to.feature","feature.name","feature.strand"

head(getAssociationWithTSS(diffAnn))

#    target.row dist.to.feature feature.name feature.strand
#573          1          -95409 NM_001204371              +
#577          2           54200 NM_001195732              +
#578          3          772869    NM_183028              +
#122          4           -9021    NM_177547              +
#25           5           24585 NM_001289497              -
#594          6         -117775 NM_001081209              -



My question may be naive but I can't seem to figure out how to achieve this particular goal:

-How can I obtain a dataframe with the column data from both of the previous objects (myDiff25p and diffAnn) on it?

-Or at least, how can I annotate the object myDiff25 without losing the information about Differential Methylation ("pvalue", "qvalue", "meth.diff") for each of the annotated rows?

Thanks in advance for your attention

JL

messages.author: eb5c6aa9d41336d1
messages.subject: Re: Annotate differentially methylated regions keeping  (pvalue, qvalue and meth.diff) fileds on the result
parts:
Hello again,

After dealing with this subject for a while, I believe that another option would be to implement the annotation of myDiff25p object.
This way users would get a differential Methylation object, but already annotated with the nearest gene, to be easily written in a single table.
Have you already done that and I just simply wasn't able to access that data? If not, do you think this could be easily achieved?

Thanks once again

JL

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Annotate differentially methylated regions keeping (pvalue, qvalue and meth.diff) fileds on the result
parts:
Hi,
This or sth along these lines works. 

da <- getAssociationWithTSS(diffAnn)
merged.table<-cbind(myDiff25p[da$target.row],da)

Similar question has been asked before, you can also check that
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/methylkit_discussion/target.row/methylkit_discussion/-9YcIP5MsEE/W5YVTqzMapoJ

Best,
Altuna
